verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly cover both referenced and unreferenced refunds via the Terminal API, refunds from the Customer Area dashboard, and Terminal API support for issuing refunds via API — covering POS, dashboard, and API paths for refunds to original card. Partial vs full refund amount handling and independent hands-on confirmation are not detailed. missing for 10: explicit confirmation of partial refund amount support, independent/hands-on verification of the refund flow, and detail on refund-to-original-card guarantee.
